verdicts.reason: Both crop the robot vacuum into an unreadable dark smear, shrink the purple circle (the brand's main shape) to a meaningless sliver in the left corner, and drop the dot pattern and frame line. The 'Smart Home / GADGETS' text is tiny and sits on dark photo instead of on the purple. A at least anchors the text to the right edge, though it's tight against it. B's text floats near the middle with an empty dark area to its right, so the placement looks arbitrary.
